goal.request: 새로 수집한 ReactorPrompt 이미지와 프롬프트를 10개 이상의 독립 주제로 분석하여 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩을 강화할 연구 근거, 후보 계약, 혼동 경계, 게이트, 회귀 설계를 만든다.

evidence.claim: 동결 증분 코퍼스는 게시물 1,182개, 이미지 4,908장, 비어 있지 않은 프롬프트 924개, 고유 본문 904개, 누락 프롬프트 258개이며 ID 범위는 1565–2746이다.
각 주제는 924개 프롬프트 전수 스캔, 최소 12개 게시물·24개 이미지의 양성 및 근접대조 검토, authored-source 소유권 대조, prompt와 pixel 증거 분리, exact와 advisory 분리, thumbnail/native gate와 held-out 설계를 공통 방법으로 사용했다.
16개 주제 보고서가 모두 프롬프트 924개를 전수 스캔했고, 합계 게시물 검토 301회와 이미지 검토 593회를 기록했다. 같은 게시물과 이미지는 여러 주제에서 반복 검토될 수 있어 합계는 고유 수가 아니다.
전달된 코퍼스 픽셀 표본에서는 exact 문구의 부분 구현, 장비·렌즈·소재·감정 라벨과 실제 가시 효과의 분리, 크롭·가림으로 인한 관찰 불가, 긴 negative 목록과 결과 품질의 비결정성이 반복해서 관찰됐다. 이 관찰은 새 제안의 독립 렌더 자격 증거가 아니다.
evidence.artifact: all 16 topic reports, pixel-side observations and evidence appendices

evidence.claim: 동결 authored data에는 이미 다수의 좁은 exact profile과 풍부한 후보가 있으며, 주요 공백은 새 명사 수보다 provenance, typed relation, single owner, observability, and evidence-layer separation이다. Generated indexes are derivative only.

evidence.claim: Cross-topic synthesis recommends a shared photo-visual-relation/v1 metadata contract, exact-source activation guard, observability and proof budget, fixture lineage, and separate package, prompt, request, render, and user evidence before topic-specific promotion.

Unrelated pre-existing and concurrent working-tree changes outside the research directory were preserved and excluded from this study's baseline authority. This study intentionally made no target-skill runtime, generated-index, or test change.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: 각 선택된 시각 의미는 출처, 단일 소유자, 관찰 가능한 구성 관계, 혼동 음성, 가시성 자격, thumbnail/native gate를 함께 보존하고, exact 근거가 없는 검색 발견은 hard obligation이 되지 않아야 한다.

invariants.statement: 정확 요청 또는 authored exact evidence만 request-scoped hard 의미를 만들 수 있고 BM25F, embedding, 빈도, 장르 연상은 advisory로 남는다.
각 핵심 의미는 이름 목록이 아니라 actor, object, region, source, contact, vector, state, topology 또는 consequence 중 필요한 관계를 정확히 하나의 canonical owner 아래 가진다.
causal_controls: one owner axis per active relation
cross-slot IDs share entity and region identifiers
duplicate prose does not create duplicate obligations

invariants.statement: 필수 영역이 크롭, 가림, 해상도 또는 전달 부재로 판정 불가능하면 해당 축은 UNSCORED이며, 보이는 일부 구성만 구현되면 strict profile은 partial_is_fail이다.
causal_controls: thumbnail and native review scales remain separate

invariants.statement: 장비, 렌즈 수치, RAW, 브랜드, 소재명, 감정 및 장르 라벨은 요청 메타데이터나 advisory alias일 수 있으나 원근, 신호 응답, 표면 거동, 얼굴 동작 또는 관계 픽셀을 자동 증명하지 않는다.
causal_controls: preserve exact input label when requested
do not infer nonvisual identity, material composition, relationship, or functional truth

invariants.statement: 프롬프트 관찰, package 구조, composed prompt, runtime request, 전달 픽셀, 새 independent render, 사용자 판단은 서로 교환할 수 없는 증거층이다.
causal_controls: corpus pixels do not qualify a new intervention

flexible_dimensions: aesthetic style not locked by the requester
incidental camera or lighting choices that preserve the owned relation
minor subject placement outside required anchors
advisory candidate ordering before explicit selection
domain-specific vocabulary that does not alter the shared relation contract

mismatches.source_state: The corpus and baseline contain abundant style, place, wardrobe, camera, material, and expression vocabulary.
mismatches.render_state: Delivered corpus examples repeatedly vary or substitute the intended contact, topology, effect owner, consequence, or readable region despite that vocabulary.

mismatches.source_state: Prompts frequently name focal length, aperture, device, RAW, film stock, CCD, fabric, or emotional labels.
mismatches.render_state: Exact numeric cause, device identity, fiber composition, and hidden affect are not recoverable from one image; only visible projection, focus, signal, surface, and facial-action relations can be scored.

mismatches.source_state: Hundreds of prompts contain long and repeated negative directives for anatomy, text, style, skin, and artifacts.
mismatches.render_state: Negative wording does not prove positive subject survival, local relation correctness, or texture preservation, and some named artifacts are intentionally requested effects.

mismatches.source_state: Prompts may request feet, contact, pores, strands, eye direction, material weave, text, or topology as detailed evidence.
mismatches.render_state: Crop, occlusion, distance, blur, panel size, or delivery role can make those regions unscoreable even when the broad scene remains attractive.

hypotheses.statement: A shared provenance and ownership envelope plus topic-specific typed IRs will reduce contradictory or scattered component selection without installing one monolithic visual slot.
hypotheses.falsifier: The implemented composer already preserves one owner, source span, shared entity IDs, relation topology, and confusion boundaries for every held-out topic without the proposed metadata.

hypotheses.statement: Required-region and review-scale metadata will prevent close crops, occlusion, and low-resolution outputs from being scored as successful detailed semantics or generic quality failure.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out close, wide, occluded, and panel cases receive correct PASS, FAIL, and UNSCORED states without any explicit observability metadata.

hypotheses.statement: Positive invariants plus profile-local false substitutes and term-level conflict metadata will prevent more failures than copying long corpus negative footers into global defaults.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched held-out tests show that blanket negative import consistently preserves requested artifacts and outperforms positive owned relations without suppressing valid modes.

hypotheses.statement: Per-clause provenance, scope, polarity, requirement mode, priority, variant, and gate mapping will distinguish real contradictions from valid regional, panel, actor, or negative-context differences.
hypotheses.falsifier: Lexical pair detection alone resolves option inventories, bilingual duplication, panel ownership, non-image payloads, and exact-versus-advisory provenance across held-outs without false conflict.

hypotheses.statement: A domain-neutral subject relation budget will preserve product, food, architecture, nature, system, and documentary evidence propositions without importing portrait-first hierarchy.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent non-portrait held-outs retain domain subject priority, state, support, scale, path, and evidence reference under the current portrait-oriented routing without a domain-neutral budget.

intervention.general_rule: Add shared provenance, single-owner relation, observability, exact-activation, fixture-lineage, and evidence-layer contracts first; then qualify topic-specific advisory IRs and only narrow request-scoped exact profiles with causal and held-out tests.
intervention.generalization_basis: The same ownership, observability, provenance, and evidence-separation gaps recur independently across composition, pose, optics, lighting, color, environment, interaction, multi-subject, face, wardrobe, human surface, capture, timing, failure prevention, prompt architecture, and non-portrait domains.

decision.rationale: The frozen corpus and 16 independent topic reports support a bounded cross-topic representation and validation backlog, but no target-skill implementation, package or prompt evaluation, independent candidate render, or user judgment has occurred.
